y > 92x + b
In the given inequality, b is a positive constant. Which of the following does NOT contain any points (x, y) in the xy−plane that are solutions to this inequality?
questions.explanation: If x > 0 and b > 0, then (9/2)x + b is positive, so y must be greater than a positive number. No point with y < 0 can satisfy the inequality.

questions.question: The function h is defined by h(x) = 3x − 4. If h(2c) = 26, what is the value of c?
The function f is defined by f(x) = 6x + 14. What is the y−coordinate of the y−intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy−plane?
questions.explanation: The y-intercept occurs at x = 0, where f(0) = 14.

Hassan put up wire fencing along each edge of a rectangular garden with a length of x feet and a width of y feet. Hassan put up a total length of 44 feet of wire fencing. Which equation represents this situation?
questions.explanation: The perimeter is 2x + 2y = 44.

questions.question:
y > 97x + b
In the given inequality, b is a positive constant. Which of the following does NOT contain any points (x, y) in the xy−plane that are solutions to this inequality?
options: The region where x < 0 and y < 0
The region where x < 0 and y > 0
The region where x > 0 and y > 0
The region where x > 0 and y < 0
questions.explanation: When x > 0 the right side (9/7)x + b is positive, so y would have to be greater than a positive number. No point with x > 0 and y < 0 can satisfy this.

questions.question:
x2 + 49x + 1 = 0
What is one of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.explanation: For ax^2 + bx + c = 0 the quadratic formula is x = (−b ± √(b^2 − 4ac))/(2a). Here a = 1, b = 49, c = 1, which matches choice A.

The function f is defined by f(x) = 56(0.19)^x. For any positive integer n, the value of f(n) is p% less than the value of f(n − 1). What is the value of p?
questions.explanation: f(n) = 0.19 · f(n − 1), so each value is 81% less than the previous one.

questions.question: A certain elephant calf weighed 226 pounds when it was born. The elephant calf gained an average of 3 pounds per day in its first year of life. Which equation models this situation, where y is the estimated weight of the elephant calf, in pounds, x days after it was born?
questions.explanation: The starting weight is 226 pounds and 3 pounds are added each day, so y = 226 + 3x.

questions.question: A town manager selected 2 random samples of residents in the town to estimate the percentage of all residents that planned to vote in favor of a new business in the downtown area. Based on the first sample, he estimated that 75% of the residents in town planned to vote in favor, with an associate margin of error of 8.3%. Based on the second sample, he estimated that 83% of the residents in the town planned to vote in favor, with an associated margin of error of 6.7%. Assuming the margins of error were calculated the same way, which of the following best explains why the first sample obtained a larger margin of error than the second sample?
options: The first sample contained fewer residents than the second sample.
The first sample contained more residents than the second sample.
The first sample contained a lower percentage of residents that planned to vote in favor of a new business in the downtown area
The first sample contained higher percentage of residents that planned to vote in favor of a new business in the downtown area
questions.topic: Inference from sample statistics and margin of error

questions.question: The area of triangle ABC is 210 square centimeters. What is the height h, in centimeters, of this triangle?
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2)(base)(height), so 210 = (1/2)(10)h = 5h, giving h = 42.

questions.question: A partially filled container containing 26 milliliters of water is placed under a leaky faucet that produces one 0.08-milliliter drop of water every 8 seconds. Until the container is full, which of the following can be used to represent the volume v, in milliliters, of water in the container t seconds after it is placed under the faucet, where t is a multiple of 8?
questions.explanation: The rate is 0.08/8 = 0.01 milliliters per second, starting from 26.

An arborist measured and recorded the heights of red maple trees in a certain area. Of the red maple tree heights recorded in this area, the minimum was 42 feet and the maximum was 57 feet. Which inequality is true for all possible values of t, where t represents the recorded height, in feet, of a red maple tree in this area?
questions.explanation: Every recorded height is between the minimum 42 and the maximum 57.

questions.question:
6(t + 7) − 8(t + 7) = 38
What value of t is the solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Combine like terms: −2(t + 7) = 38, so t + 7 = −19 and t = −26.

questions.question: 3y = 8x + 18 and −3y = 7x − 26. The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 30x?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives 0 = 15x − 8, so x = 8/15 and 30x = 16.

questions.question: The graph of the linear equation 4x + By = 12 is shown, where B is a constant. What is the value of B?
questions.explanation: The line passes through (0, 2). Substituting: 4(0) + B(2) = 12, so B = 6.

questions.question: Each 3.0-ounce serving of cheddar cheese and each 1.2-ounce serving of tuna provides about 1 microgram of vitamin B12. If a total of 3.6 micrograms of vitamin B12 are consumed from eating x ounces of cheese and y ounces of tuna, which equation best represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Cheese provides 1/3.0 ≈ 0.33 microgram per ounce and tuna provides 1/1.2 ≈ 0.83 microgram per ounce, so 0.33x + 0.83y = 3.6.

questions.question: A small business budgeted $1,000 to spend on printers and toner cartridges. The small business paid $300 for each printer and $50 for each toner cartridge. The entire budget was spent to purchase 2 printers and several toner cartridges. How many toner cartridges were purchased?

The function f(x) = 236(1.022)<sup>x</sup> models the value, in dollars, of a certain bank account from 1958 through 1973, where x is the number of years after the end of 1958. Which of the following is the best interpretation of “f(5) is approximately equal to 263” in this context?
options: The value of the bank account is estimated to increase by approximately 263 dollars every 5 years between the end of 1958 and the end of 1973.
The value, in dollars, of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 times greater at the end of 1963 than at the end of 1958.
The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 dollars greater at the end of 1963 than at the end of 1958.
The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 263 dollars at the end of 1963.
questions.explanation: x = 5 is 5 years after the end of 1958, the end of 1963, and f(5) is the account’s value then.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (5x<sup>3</sup> − 3x + 8) − (9x<sup>6</sup> + 5x − 3)?
questions.explanation: Distribute the negative: −9x^6 + 5x^3 − 3x − 5x + 8 + 3 = −9x^6 + 5x^3 − 8x + 11.

questions.explanation: Side RS = 23 is opposite angle Q and QS is the hypotenuse, so sin Q = 23/QS and QS = 23/sin Q.

questions.question: In right triangle ABC shown, what is the measure of ∠C?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle sum to 180°, so ∠C = 180° − 90° − 56° = 34°.

questions.question: Circle K has a radius of 2 millimeters (mm). Circle L has an area of 144π mm<sup>2</sup>. What is the total area, in mm<sup>2</sup>, of circles K and L?
questions.explanation: Circle K has area 4π, so the total is 4π + 144π = 148π.
